blind.description: A grand medieval-style stone fireplace featuring a heavy stepped base hearth, an open firebox containing iron andirons and logs, decorative side pillars with carved capitals, a prominent mantelpiece with carved leaf friezes, and a tapered stone chimney breast centered with a carved heraldic shield within a circular wreath, capped with a flat rectangular coping.
blind.from_above: A tiered rectangular profile centered on a flat stone top cap, stepping out to the sloped chimney hood, wide projecting mantel shelf, and base corners.
blind.height_vs_figure: Slightly shorter than the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 5 ft tall) and roughly 4.5 to 5 ft wide.

notes: carved heraldic shield relief on chimney hood
gemini note: carved heraldic shield relief on chimney hood
